fee_notes: The initial Franchise Fee for a first Black Bear Diner restaurant is $55,000. For franchisees already operating existing locations, the fee follows a tiered schedule based on total number of franchised restaurants: 1-2 = $55,000; 3 = $50,000; 4-7 = $32,000; 8+ = $24,000. Under an Area Development Agreement, the Franchise Fee per restaurant is similarly tiered (1=$55,000; 2=$45,000; 3=$40,000; 4-7=$32,000; 8+=$24,000), and a Development Fee equal to 50% of the applicable Franchise Fee is paid for each restaurant beyond the first, with a credit applied when each subsequent Franchise Agreement is executed. For fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, the initial Franchise Fee ranged from $24,000 to $55,000. The fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.
